article.title: Russian deputy PM confirms strikes on 3 refineries, gas-chemical complex

article.title: Russian attacks leave consumers without power in Kyiv and four regions – Ukrenergo

article.summary: Ukraine showed to its Norwegian partners rescue equipment damaged and destroyed by Russian attacks and shared its experience of responding to strikes on energy facilities and dealing with their aftermath.

article.title: Hundreds of Ukrainian drones launched toward Moscow, mayor confirms
article.summary: More than 600 Ukrainian unmanned aerial vehicles were launched toward the Moscow region overnight, according to Russian capital officials. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin confirmed via Telegram that 613 drones targeted the metropolitan area between Wednesday night and Thursday morning.
